# Goals

- Fully assess what it will take to graduate the library from alpha to a production-ready 3.0 release and publish it to npm.
- Analyze and specify a release-certifying example portfolio covering React 19/Vite 8, Next.js, agentic A2UI, Flutter/Riverpod, and one Tauri application targeting desktop and mobile.
- Consolidate reusable Flutter entity-management and A2UI libraries from `/Users/gqadonis/Projects/hybrid-mobile-architecture-src` and `/Users/gqadonis/Projects/know-me/know-me-system` into this monorepo without importing product-specific runtime ownership or duplicating canonical packages.
- Make the examples collectively demonstrate the complete stable feature surface with deterministic, machine-verifiable coverage.
